title: Collapse-recovery model parameters and reported outcomes
transcriptionMethod: Parameters were transcribed from Table 4. Results include only values stated in prose or exactly defined by the paper; unreported chart-only values remain null pending digitization or author raw runs. Rendered pages 7 and 9-11 were visually checked.
assumptions: The paper describes 200 independent Monte Carlo simulations per scenario over 1,000 yearly time steps.
The result values are reported ensemble summaries, not independently reproduced simulation outputs.
A null result means no exact or safely rounded prose value was transcribed; it is not numeric zero.
notes: The paper's Code Availability statement on rendered page 20 links the author-hosted public repository https://github.com/celiablanco/technocycles. At audited commit 910770dbe9224a9f7b1e003fdc7c000c2d78a5c2, notebooks/figures.ipynb contains the simulation and figure code and initializes the main Monte Carlo generator with seed 12345; sensitivity batches use seed 54321.

The same commit contains notebooks/technosphere_summary.csv with aggregate results but no committed per-run trajectories. The repository declares no software or data license, so neither code nor CSV is ingested into canonical runtime data pending rights clarification.
This dataset therefore remains a transcription of the CC BY 4.0 paper; its result values have not been replaced by the unlicensed aggregate CSV.
Figure-only values are intentionally not guessed from bar heights.

parameterDefinitions.label: Technological growth rate
parameterDefinitions.definition: Fixed linear annual increase in technological capacity.

parameterDefinitions.label: Initial resource stock
parameterDefinitions.definition: Resource stock available at the beginning of a run.

parameterDefinitions.label: Resource depletion rate
parameterDefinitions.definition: Constant annual decrease in available resource stock.

parameterDefinitions.label: Collapse survival fraction
parameterDefinitions.definition: Fraction of technological capacity retained through a collapse event.

parameterDefinitions.label: Recovery delay
parameterDefinitions.definition: Dormant period before growth and resource use resume after collapse.

parameterDefinitions.label: Recovery fraction
parameterDefinitions.definition: Fraction of original resource stock restored after the recovery delay.

parameterDefinitions.label: Existential hazard rate
parameterDefinitions.definition: Fixed annual probability of an exogenous collapse-triggering event.
